methodology.precision_at_k: Relevant unique retrieved passages / requested k; missing ranks count as nonrelevant.
methodology.passage_relevance: Same source document/hash and intersection / min(passage length, gold span length) >= the fixed overlap threshold.
methodology.recall_at_k: Fraction of distinct gold evidence spans with union coverage >= the fixed overlap threshold in the top k. Overlaps are merged before counting coverage.
methodology.mrr: Reciprocal rank of the first relevant passage, averaged over answerable questions and repetitions; 0 when none is relevant.
methodology.scope: Only answerable questions with validated source evidence enter P/R/MRR. Unanswerable questions have undefined retrieval P/R/MRR and a separately reported retrieval abstention rate.
methodology.duplicates: Repeated identical document/start/end hits do not count twice; original ranks are retained. Different overlapping passages can both be relevant, but cannot inflate evidence recall.
methodology.answer_correctness: Optional normalized exact match against reference answers, only for successfully generated, answerable outputs. Not a semantic correctness judge.
methodology.groundedness: Automated semantic groundedness is not evaluated. Explicit attributed human claim reviews are exported separately with their rubric, sample sizes and as-of time. Quote validation alone proves provenance, not semantic support.
methodology.latency: Actual query embedding + index validation/load/search time after one excluded warm-up per configuration. Query repetitions are not independent questions.

rubric.correctness: Against the supplied human reference: incorrect=0, partial=0.5, correct=1. Not evaluated is null. Human judgment, not calibrated semantic equivalence.
rubric.groundedness: Judge every displayed answer claim against retrieved source passages. supported=1, unsupported=0. The mean is reported only if all claims are judged; any uncertain rating keeps the score null. Citation quote presence alone is not semantic support.
rubric.abstention: For an explicit insufficient-context answer, correctness may be judged against a reference; claim groundedness is inapplicable and remains null.
rubric.identity: Reviewer names are self-attestations in this local single-user application, not authenticated identities.

human_answer_evaluation.limitation: Post-run human judgments are separate from immutable automated metrics. Counts refer to answer judgments, not independent questions; repeated queries do not increase independent sample size. Small or selected review samples are not general quality estimates.

analysis.methodology: Quality = normalized weighted recall/MRR/precision. Speed = inverse min-max mean latency in feasible cohort (1 if equal). Score = accuracy_weight*quality + (1-accuracy_weight)*speed. Pareto dominance maximizes this quality and minimizes latency over all complete configs before applying the latency constraint.
analysis.caution: Exploratory point estimates. Bootstrap intervals are not superiority tests; no multiple-comparison correction. Evidence groups/duplicates must remain in one split; manually check semantic paraphrases. Tiny or unreviewed samples cannot support general superiority claims.
